Leah (People Ops): Quick Q from a manager: if an employee leaves mid-month and requests a direct rollover of their 401(k) to an IRA, what's the exact steps? Manager worried about withholding/tax mistakes.
Omar (Payroll): Payroll side: we stop deferrals on termination date. For distributions, vendor handles trustee-to-trustee rollovers if employee signs the rollover form. No withholding if trustee-to-trustee.
Tess (Benefits): Vendor (Fidelity) requires a signed distribution/rollover election and a receiving-IRA account number. They prefer completed trustee-to-trustee forms. If employee elects cash-out, 20% mandatory federal withholding applies for eligible distributions.
Leah (People Ops): So the key is to collect the signed rollover election before payroll finalizes?
Omar (Payroll): More like before we submit the final payroll remittance for the termination pay period. If distribution is processed after funds moved, tax withholding may already be applied. Time-sensitive.
Ruben (Legal): Also check state tax rules for withholding and potential mandatory notices. If employee is non-US or has foreign-sourced accounts, there are extra steps.
Tess (Benefits): Actionable checklist I use: 1) Employee completes Fidelity rollover form (e-sign accepted) 2) Benefits confirms receiving-IRA details and validates account # 3) People Ops records termination date and confirms distribution type 4) Payroll holds until Benefits confirms trustee-to-trustee transfer scheduled.
HelpBot: Template: `employee_id,last4,termination_date,rollover_choice,ira_institution,ira_account_mask`
Leah (People Ops): Can we make a one-page checklist for managers to hand departing employees? Managers often miss the timing.
Omar (Payroll): Yes — short checklist plus a note about tax outcomes for cash-outs. I'll draft the payroll timing bullet.
Tess (Benefits): I'll draft the vendor-specific step-by-step and a sample e-sign link. Also include HSA rollover note: HSAs can be rolled to another HSA trustee; cashing HSA is taxable + penalty if under 65.
Ruben (Legal): I'll add required language about consent/authorization and for internationals.
Leah (People Ops): Great. Owners: Omar payroll timing bullet by 3pm; Tess vendor form + HSA note by 4pm; Ruben legal blurb by 5pm. I'll assemble manager checklist and post company template.
